decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.
Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.
Condition : 3 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: Drawing AL25/18HR/07 (Rev.1), received 08/10/2025. Biodiversity Statement, received 17/09/2025. Drawing AL25/18-22HR/17(Rev.00) and Operation hours letter, received 02/08/2025. Drawings AL25/18-22HR/01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06, 07, 09, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15 and 16, Design and Access Strategy and Fire Strategy (dated 26/05/2025), received 27/05/2025.

Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.
Condition : 4 - The approved MOT garage business shall not operate outside the following hours:
�	Monday to Friday: 08:00-17:00 
�	Saturday: 08:00-13:00 
�	Sunday and Bank Holidays: Closed
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' living conditions. 
Condition : 5 - All refuse and recycling bins, delivery cages, trolleys or any other items linked to deliveries and collection in association with the approved development are to be stored securely within the building at all times, without blocking any entrances or other accesses, and only brought out onto the public highway when deliveries are being made or refuse collected. Any such provisions shall be completed and made available for use before the development herby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, and shall be retained thereafter at all times without obstruction. 
Reason: To protect the quality of the local environment and to prevent obstruction and inconvenience to users of the public highway
Reason: In order to ensure adequate provision for waste and recycling without prejudicing pedestrian or highway safety or harming the amenities of the area.
Condition : 6 - Secure covered cycle parking facilities for staff and visitors to the development shall be installed in a readily accessible location within the site. The approved facilities shall conform with London Plan standards in respect of the number of spaces, and with the current Westtrans West London Cycle Parking Guidance (or such other guidance as shall supersede it) in design and layout, and shall be fully implemented and made available for use within 3 months of the completion of development works and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.
Reason: In order to support sustainable transport objectives.
Condition : 7 - The extensions hereby permitted shall only be used for purposes ancillary to the repositioned MOT garage premises hereby approved, and shall not be used as extensions to the existing commercial premises on the ground floor of Gill House, 18-20 Harlington Road West, or the residential use of the rest of the building, nor shall any internal entrance be provided from Gill House into these extensions.
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' living conditions and the character of the area.
description: Relocation of MOT garage further to rear of site and formation of ancillary single storey extensions for storage, office and reception/waiting space associated with the re-provided MOT garage.
subdivision_of_building: The construction of a single-storey rear extension to enlarge the ground floor shops 5 meters in depth for each of the three; The relocation of the adjoining MOT garage 6 meters further back, establishing a 1-meter wide access gap between the new rear extension and the garage.
